title: Fast-talking HVAC owner gives it all
persona: Rick Donovan, HVAC owner in Phoenix, fast talker, decisive, no small talk.
goal: Book the setup call in as few turns as possible.
opening_line: Rick Donovan, HVAC, Phoenix, we miss like half our calls in summer, I want AVA answering them, book me a setup call Wednesday at ten.

turns.caller: Yeah, Wednesday ten works, that's it, what else you need?
Quick, what's the price so I know?
Good. How does it handle a no-AC emergency?
Great. Anything I have to prep?
Cool. Confirm it back to me.

curveballs: Gives business, pain, and booking request in the first line
Wants a rapid read-back of the details
expected: Does not re-ask business type, city, or pain he already stated
Moves straight to confirming the Wednesday 10 time and collecting a number
Quotes $497 a month plus $497 one-time setup
Reads back the booking accurately: Rick Donovan, Wednesday at ten, 414-555-0111
